payload.recallText: It is told as memories from the perspective of one of the children. They come from a family that is obsessed with the Kennedys. Their father even bought their mother a wedding ring that matches the one JFK gave jackie. A lot of their family activities revolve around the Kennedys. They like to vacation near where the Kennedy's vacation in the summer, and one day when the aunts are busy spying on the compound, the kids get spwept away in the ocean and the Kennedy boys have to save them in a motor boat.  This makes the Aunts mad at the kids because the Kennedys have been through so much already.
